from pathlib import Path
import zipfile, shutil, tempfile, os
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

path = Path('/home/user/SmallBalanceSheet.xlsx')
backup = path.with_suffix('.xlsx.bak')
if not backup.exists():
    shutil.copy2(path, backup)

NS_MAIN = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
NS_REL = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships'
NS_PKGREL = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships'
NS_CT = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types'

ET.register_namespace('', NS_MAIN)
ET.register_namespace('r', NS_REL)
ET.register_namespace('', NS_PKGREL)
ET.register_namespace('', NS_CT)

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    td = Path(td)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path, 'r') as zin:
        zin.extractall(td)

    workbook_path = td / 'xl' / 'workbook.xml'
    rels_path = td / 'xl' / '_rels' / 'workbook.xml.rels'
    types_path = td / '[Content_Types].xml'
    styles_path = td / 'xl' / 'styles.xml'
    sheet2_path = td / 'xl' / 'worksheets' / 'sheet2.xml'

    wb_tree = ET.parse(workbook_path)
    wb_root = wb_tree.getroot()
    sheets = wb_root.find(f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}sheets')
    # Remove existing Sheet2 entry if rerun, then recreate deterministically.
    for sheet in list(sheets):
        if sheet.get('name') == 'Sheet2':
            sheets.remove(sheet)
    max_sheet_id = max(int(s.get('sheetId')) for s in sheets)

    rels_tree = ET.parse(rels_path)
    rels_root = rels_tree.getroot()
    for rel in list(rels_root):
        if rel.get('Target') == 'worksheets/sheet2.xml':
            rels_root.remove(rel)
    used = {rel.get('Id') for rel in rels_root}
    rid_num = 1
    while f'rId{rid_num}' in used:
        rid_num += 1
    new_rid = f'rId{rid_num}'
    ET.SubElement(rels_root, f'{{{NS_PKGREL}}}Relationship', {
        'Id': new_rid,
        'Type': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/worksheet',
        'Target': 'worksheets/sheet2.xml',
    })
    ET.SubElement(sheets, f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}sheet', {
        'name': 'Sheet2',
        'sheetId': str(max_sheet_id + 1),
        f'{{{NS_REL}}}id': new_rid,
    })

    types_tree = ET.parse(types_path)
    types_root = types_tree.getroot()
    part_name = '/xl/worksheets/sheet2.xml'
    exists = any(e.get('PartName') == part_name for e in types_root)
    if not exists:
        ET.SubElement(types_root, f'{{{NS_CT}}}Override', {
            'PartName': part_name,
            'ContentType': 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.worksheet+xml',
        })

    styles_tree = ET.parse(styles_path)
    styles_root = styles_tree.getroot()
    cell_xfs = styles_root.find(f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}cellXfs')
    percent_style = len(list(cell_xfs))
    ET.SubElement(cell_xfs, f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}xf', {
        'numFmtId': '10',
        'fontId': '0',
        'fillId': '0',
        'borderId': '0',
        'xfId': '0',
        'applyNumberFormat': '1',
    })
    cell_xfs.set('count', str(percent_style + 1))

    def c_text(parent, ref, text):
        c = ET.SubElement(parent, f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}c', {'r': ref, 't': 'inlineStr'})
        is_el = ET.SubElement(c, f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}is')
        ET.SubElement(is_el, f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}t').text = text

    def c_num(parent, ref, value):
        c = ET.SubElement(parent, f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}c', {'r': ref})
        ET.SubElement(c, f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}v').text = str(value)

    def c_formula(parent, ref, formula):
        c = ET.SubElement(parent, f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}c', {'r': ref, 's': str(percent_style)})
        ET.SubElement(c, f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}f').text = formula

    ws = ET.Element(f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}worksheet', {
        'xmlns:r': NS_REL,
    })
    ET.SubElement(ws, f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}dimension', {'ref': 'A1:D6'})
    sheet_views = ET.SubElement(ws, f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}sheetViews')
    sheet_view = ET.SubElement(sheet_views, f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}sheetView', {'workbookViewId': '0'})
    ET.SubElement(sheet_view, f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}selection', {'activeCell': 'A1', 'sqref': 'A1'})
    ET.SubElement(ws, f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}sheetFormatPr', {'defaultRowHeight': '15'})
    cols = ET.SubElement(ws, f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}cols')
    for i, width in enumerate([12, 14, 14, 14], start=1):
        ET.SubElement(cols, f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}col', {'min': str(i), 'max': str(i), 'width': str(width), 'customWidth': '1'})
    data = ET.SubElement(ws, f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}sheetData')
    row1 = ET.SubElement(data, f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}row', {'r': '1'})
    for ref, text in [('A1','Year'), ('B1','CA changes'), ('C1','FA changes'), ('D1','OA changes')]:
        c_text(row1, ref, text)
    for out_row, src_row, year in zip(range(2, 7), range(3, 8), range(2015, 2020)):
        row = ET.SubElement(data, f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}row', {'r': str(out_row)})
        c_num(row, f'A{out_row}', year)
        prev = src_row - 1
        c_formula(row, f'B{out_row}', f\"('Sheet1'"'!B{src_row}-'"'Sheet1'"'!B{prev})/'"'Sheet1'"'!B{prev}")
        c_formula(row, f'"'C{out_row}', f\"('Sheet1'"'!C{src_row}-'"'Sheet1'"'!C{prev})/'"'Sheet1'"'!C{prev}")
        c_formula(row, f'"'D{out_row}', f\"('Sheet1'"'!D{src_row}-'"'Sheet1'"'!D{prev})/'"'Sheet1'"'!D{prev}")
    ET.SubElement(ws, f'"'{{{NS_MAIN}}}pageMargins', {
        'left': '0.7', 'right': '0.7', 'top': '0.75', 'bottom': '0.75', 'header': '0.3', 'footer': '0.3'
    })
    ET.ElementTree(ws).write(sheet2_path, encoding='UTF-8', xml_declaration=True)

    wb_tree.write(workbook_path, encoding='UTF-8', xml_declaration=True)
    rels_tree.write(rels_path, encoding='UTF-8', xml_declaration=True)
    types_tree.write(types_path, encoding='UTF-8', xml_declaration=True)
    styles_tree.write(styles_path, encoding='UTF-8', xml_declaration=True)

    new_path = path.with_suffix('.xlsx.tmp')
    with zipfile.ZipFile(new_path, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
        for file in sorted(td.rglob('*')):
            if file.is_file():
                zout.write(file, file.relative_to(td).as_posix())
    os.replace(new_path, path)

print('Updated', path)
print('Backup at', backup)

            rels_root.remove(rel)
    used = {rel.get('Id') for rel in rels_root}
    rid_num = 1
    while f'rId{rid_num}' in used:
        rid_num += 1
    new_rid = f'rId{rid_num}'
    ET.SubElement(rels_root, f'{{{NS_PKGREL}}}Relationship', {
        'Id': new_rid,
        'Type': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/worksheet',
        'Target': 'worksheets/sheet2.xml',
    })
    ET.SubElement(sheets, f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}sheet', {
        'name': 'Sheet2',
        'sheetId': str(max_sheet_id + 1),
        f'{{{NS_REL}}}id': new_rid,
    })

    types_tree = ET.parse(types_path)
    types_root = types_tree.getroot()
    part_name = '/xl/worksheets/sheet2.xml'
    exists = any(e.get('PartName') == part_name for e in types_root)
    if not exists:
        ET.SubElement(types_root, f'{{{NS_CT}}}Override', {

            'ContentType': 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.worksheet+xml',
        })

    styles_tree = ET.parse(styles_path)
    styles_root = styles_tree.getroot()
    cell_xfs = styles_root.find(f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}cellXfs')
    percent_style = len(list(cell_xfs))
    ET.SubElement(cell_xfs, f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}xf', {

    })
    cell_xfs.set('count', str(percent_style + 1))

    def c_text(parent, ref, text):
        c = ET.SubElement(parent, f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}c', {'r': ref, 't': 'inlineStr'})
        is_el = ET.SubElement(c, f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}is')
        ET.SubElement(is_el, f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}t').text = text

    def c_num(parent, ref, value):
        c = ET.SubElement(parent, f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}c', {'r': ref})
        ET.SubElement(c, f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}v').text = str(value)

    def c_formula(parent, ref, formula):
        c = ET.SubElement(parent, f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}c', {'r': ref, 's': str(percent_style)})

    cols = ET.SubElement(ws, f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}cols')
    for i, width in enumerate([12, 14, 14, 14], start=1):

    data = ET.SubElement(ws, f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}sheetData')
    row1 = ET.SubElement(data, f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}row', {'r': '1'})
    for ref, text in [('A1','Year'), ('B1','CA changes'), ('C1','FA changes'), ('D1','OA changes')]:

    for out_row, src_row, year in zip(range(2, 7), range(3, 8), range(2015, 2020)):

        c_formula(row, f'B{out_row}', f\"('Sheet1'"'!B{src_row}-'"'Sheet1'"'!B{prev})/'"'Sheet1'"'!B{prev}")
        c_formula(row, f'"'C{out_row}', f\"('Sheet1'"'!C{src_row}-'"'Sheet1'"'!C{prev})/'"'Sheet1'"'!C{prev}")
        c_formula(row, f'"'D{out_row}', f\"('Sheet1'"'!D{src_row}-'"'Sheet1'"'!D{prev})/'"'Sheet1'"'!D{prev}")
    ET.SubElement(ws, f'"'{{{NS_MAIN}}}pageMargins', {
